constraint.cypher: MATCH (f:Yaml:File)-[:HAS_DOCUMENT|HAS_MAP|HAS_KEY|HAS_VALUE|HAS_ITEM*1..14]->(s:Yaml:Scalar) WHERE s.value =~ '.*-D(skipTests|skipITs|maven\\.test\\.skip)(=true)?.*' RETURN DISTINCT f AS Element, f.fileName AS Fqn, s.value AS Detail

constraint.description: Third-party actions must be pinned to a commit SHA, not to a movable tag.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (f:Yaml:File)-[:HAS_DOCUMENT|HAS_MAP|HAS_KEY|HAS_VALUE|HAS_ITEM*1..14]->(k:Yaml:Key {name: 'uses'})-[:HAS_VALUE]->(v:Yaml:Scalar) WHERE v.value CONTAINS '@' AND NOT v.value =~ '.*@[0-9a-f]{40}$' RETURN DISTINCT f AS Element, f.fileName AS Fqn, v.value AS Detail
